dataset: Existing pinned DuRetrieval source-dev full corpus, all 2000 queries; no blog tuning or new embedding calls

candidate_policy.rerank_scope: exact same document union, at most 48; no filtering or added candidates

input_policy.name: first-production-rrf-locator-pair-v1
input_policy.passage: first existing production RRF source match with title prefix; no new source window or answer-label selection
input_policy.truncation: only_second, preserve complete query; record exact visible source offsets
input_policy.score: raw single logit, descending; ties retain fixed RRF order

model.representation: community ONNX dynamic INT8; do not call it official full-precision quality
model.control: same fixed public/synthetic pair inputs on author's official FP32 ONNX; report logits/ranks and timing without claiming exhaustive equivalence

decision_budget.scope: Project decision budget, not an industry universal standard or a production release claim
decision_budget.production_default: A public-dev pass alone does not enable a new production dependency; state explicitly which quality/latency conditions pass or fail

metrics: warm query p50/p95/p99 and cold load
cmrc: Only source-input budget/evidence coverage audit if useful; known-source single candidate needs no reranker model call and cannot measure reranking quality
failure_review: 5-10 deterministic examples spanning candidate miss, RRF suppression, reranker recovery/regression and truncated input; IDs and analytical paraphrases, not redistributed source documents
end_condition: Finish this single-model controlled run, reproduce metrics, write adoption decision and freeze RAG. No additional model sweep, feature work, production deployment or semantic Judge. Reopen on real corpus migration with evidence labels or measured business/SLO regression.
